test.name: Spec 0010 spike: signal, reap, and helper group TERM then KILL

expected: signals reach this user's processes in another session, a zombie keeps its pid until reaped, and SIGTERM then SIGKILL to a helper's process group ends the helper and its descendants even when they ignore SIGTERM (spec 0010 AC-5, AC-15, Adapter macOS row Sinyal dan reap)
actual: kill(SIGTERM) from the spike (not the parent, another session) stopped the orphan; SIGCONT to a running process is harmless. kill(zombie, 0) succeeds before waitpid and returns ESRCH after, so the pid cannot be reused while the handle keeps the child unreaped, which is what the per-pid mutex relies on. Helper group: `sh -c "trap '' TERM; /bin/sleep 60 & exec fake serve --ignore-term=true"` spawned with SETSID gives a group of 2 (fake exec'd over sh, plus sleep); kill(-pgid, SIGTERM) leaves both alive for the 5 s grace (fake printed 'ignoring SIGTERM'); kill(-pgid, SIGKILL) ends the fake with signaled(9) and leaves the group empty.
